paragraphs: Those who decide before the Sages.
This occurs in [Gittin 42b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.42b.12) and [Kiddushin 24b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.24b.7). Rashi explains: “It was not specified who they were.”[^1]

notes.text: [Rashi on Gittin](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Gittin.42b.12.1) explicitly says that the identities of the deciding group are unspecified. Kiddushin spells their designation מכריעים.
